text.p: The suspension of trading in the shares of Malpac holdings Bhd has been extended for four trading days from Tuesday, June 3, the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) said on Monday.
It said in a statement the extension of suspension, in effect since April 21, was to enable the company announce details of an equity acquisition in a financial services company.
The suspension of trading was granted following Malpac's application to the central Bank Negara Malaysia seeking approval for the acquisition.
"If the company is still not able to make the full announcement on June 6, 1997, the suspension will be automatically lifted by the exchange on June 9, 1997," the KLSE said.
